methodology: Initial hold/combo/timeout cases inject m_airComboTarget and launch both actors to isolate hold logic.
Normal jump uses LaunchCharacter Z=420, no target; real ASC InputID3 activates air ability. This does not exercise physical Space mapping.
Integration spawns fresh target 100 cm along actual Hero forward vector; no target injection; real ASC InputID6 activates launcher and sword trace, then InputID3 starts air attack.
Normal-jump velocity is unchanged within +/-1 cm/s immediately on attack. A later sample decreases by >100 cm/s over 0.2 seconds with gravity 1.
Launcher interruption verifies both gravity values go from 0 to 1.
observed_limitations: Launcher trace missed at 140 cm in this controlled setup; 100 cm passes.
